text: Luther found the Lion as a wild child in the forests of Caliban, and raised him like a son.
They became brothers. Then the Emperor came for the Lion.
The Lion led the Dark Angels to the stars. Luther was left behind.
Year after year in the Lion's shadow, his love turned to jealousy.
The dark gods whispered, and Luther listened.
When the Lion came home, Luther turned the guns of Caliban on his brother.
The two friends fought, and Caliban broke apart around them.
The Lion vanished. Luther was taken alive, and locked away for ten thousand years.
To this day, the Dark Angels hunt the Fallen, to bury their shame.
